thread:
marco: Quick follow-up from the KV postmortem — we need final owners for: statuspage copy, customer summary, RCA sharing policy (consent + redaction), and a recurrence pattern scan. Keep replies short so CS has one thread.

anita: I can take the statuspage + short customer line. Will post two variants (consumer & enterprise) by tomorrow.

jeff: I'll draft the customer-facing two-paragraph summary and include the RCA timeline. Proposal: interim summary within 48h, full sanitized RCA within 7 days.

lina: I'll own the RCA-sharing policy. My proposal: public summary by default (48h), full sanitized RCA in 7 days, logs or detailed traces only if customer opts in via consent. I'll add a one-page redaction appendix.

marco: Sounds good. Lina, please include explicit redaction rules (remove account IDs, IPs, hostnames, customer-linked timestamps). Jeff — include the KV mitigation ETA in your note or mark as TBA.

ops-bot: Created tickets: INC-19981 (statuspage copy) -> anita, due 2026-09-12; INC-19982 (customer summary) -> jeff, due 2026-09-11; INC-19983 (RCA sharing policy + consent) -> lina, due 2026-09-13; INC-19984 (recurrence 90-day scan) -> priya, due 2026-09-18.

priya: I'll run the 90-day recurrence scan and flag repeat-affected accounts. Deliverable: short slide + recommended mitigations.

anita: Draft status copy in tracker: "We experienced intermittent write latency affecting a small number of customers. We applied mitigations to reduce impact and are investigating the root cause. A full incident report will be posted within 7 days." Enterprise variant will note coordination with AM/Legal.

jeff: Adding the customer blurb and timeline to the tracker now. KV patch ETA still pending perf runs — will update when tests complete.

lina: Policy draft uploaded: redaction checklist + consent mock text: "I authorize Redwood to share sanitized logs for troubleshooting (customer identifiers removed)." Also added a brief FAQ for CS.

marco: Agreement check: if owners miss the 48h interim, ops posts the interim public summary + statuspage link and notes "RCA in progress." For enterprise accounts, tag and route to Legal/AM before public detail.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping this thread in 48 hours if INC-19981/19982 still open.

priya: Adding priority flags for accounts with multiple hits so CS can proactively reach out.

jeff: Quick ask: when sharing sanitized RCA, include a short appendix explaining what was redacted so customers understand scope. Lina added that, good call.

anita: I'll coordinate with Legal for enterprise phrasing. If legal needs extra time we publish consumer copy and delay enterprise wording.

marco: Thanks everyone. Keep updates short here and paste JIRA links into the tracker. I'll close interim sync after the ops reminder.

[end of thread]
